name: Arizona Mobile Meat Processing
old_description: Hi my name is Jake Giles and I am the Owner/Operator of Arizona Mobile Meat Processing.  I have been cutting meat for over 20 years and have a great deal of pride doing what I do.  I started Arizona Mobile Meat Processing in 2009 here in Northern Arizona.
about:
Arizona Mobile Meat Processing operates from Williams, Arizona, where founder Jake Giles launched the business in 2009 after two decades of cutting meat. Giles serves as owner and operator of the mobile processing service, which travels to ranches and homes across northern Arizona to handle domestic livestock.

The company runs a state‑inspected facility approved for resale and carries commercial inspection from the Arizona Department of Agriculture (AZDA). Its mobile unit provides on‑site slaughter, cutting, and wrapping for beef, lamb, goats, and swine, while a separate wild‑game division processes antelope, deer, elk, and javelina during hunting seasons. The fixed location at 355 Ellen Way complements the mobile operation.

Customers include ranchers, hunting families, and local 4‑H clubs that the company sponsors. The service covers domestic livestock for private owners and auction participants (Coconino, Maricopa, Verde Valley, Yavapai county auctions) as well as hunters seeking custom processing of harvested game.

Giles started the business out of pride in his craft and a desire to bring inspected, convenient processing directly to producers and hunters in the region.
